note: FH.4a precision: the shape rule needs BOTH a path-shaped string (a `/`-led path or an http(s) URL, no whitespace) AND a method signal, and a data: / blob: / mailto: / javascript: or base64 string is never an endpoint, under any rule. `log('/tmp/x')` has no method signal; `request('users list', { method })` no path; `fetch('data:image/png;base64,..')` was minted `endpoint:GET:/data:image/png;base64,..` before FH.4a (immich's spec files minted such a node); an Express registration with an inline handler stays a ROUTE; a mock definition with a `response` is no client call; a Python dict `cache.get('/users/me')` is no call either. The positive control is the Express ROUTE.
